info.title: POSTURE Data Processing and Dashboard · HMI / ROS contract 1.0
info.description: Data processing and dashboard module: HMI/ROS acquisition by shift and workpiece iteration, plus independent laboratory tools. In strict mode, acquisition requires a ROS Bearer token or administrator session cookie. Receiving data does not imply metric calculation. Contract and examples: docs/ROS_API.md.
